title: 第十七章再杀龙平第十八章震动龙城的凶杀案
content_zh:
第十七章，再杀龙平！！
看着掌柜死不瞑目的神情，秦风并没有过多犹豫，而是蹲下身子在其身上摸索了起来。
很快，他便摸到了自己想要的东西，嘴上洋溢不住笑容道：“现在还没到入库的日子，今年龙凤楼的收益，就归我秦风了，就当是给龙野爷爷的葬礼钱吧。”
话落，秦风立马起身，开始左右四顾起来。
他知道，在这间房里，有着一处暗格，里面放着一个乾坤袋，而袋子里便是龙凤楼今年的收益。
如今和龙家已经到了水火不相容的地步，必须要多搞点灵石，以备后用才行。
只有这样，不管去哪个城市，都能借助灵石寻求庇护。
时不等人。
秦风开始忙碌起来，身法不断施展在房间里寻找，中途他还在掌柜的身上又扒了扒，将其身上的乾坤袋给找了出来。
由于时间紧急，秦风并没有检查里面有多少灵石或者珍贵之物。
但他清楚，身为龙凤楼掌柜，这家伙肯定吃的满嘴流油，只要能够完成龙家每年定下的目标，剩下的灵石，都属于他这位掌柜的私有财产了。
就在此时，二楼包间里。
龙平带着一群龙家纨绔子弟，打算趁着家族内部因为秦风之事，而无暇管自己等人时，准备在龙凤楼大吃一顿，不醉不归。
所以这才有了现在的画面。
只见龙平坐着主位，左右两侧坐着六七位龙家年轻一辈，显得威严十足。
这次前往搜捕秦风的行动，龙平虽有参与，但绝大多数时间都是在摸鱼，加上其大长老之孙的身份，让许多家族高层对他摸鱼的态度，视而不见。
包括他身边的这些狗腿子也一样。
毕竟，谁敢招惹一人之下，万人之上的家族大长老呢？
“龙平哥，多亏了你，才让我们躲过一劫，不然肯定和那些龙城修士们一样，被族长大人和那头凶鸟王的灵气波动所冲击致命或者重创。”
“是啊，龙平哥，要不是你及时带我们离开，恐怕我都已经下去见太奶了。”

“对对对，没有龙平哥，我们哪有机会还坐在这里？”
“来，大家一起敬龙平哥一杯！！”
“......”
话音落下，只见圆桌旁的龙家年轻一辈们纷纷站起身来，举杯看向龙平。
而后者则是十分享受这一时刻，他微闭双眸，脸上充满了得意之笑。
在家族之中，虽然他龙平也有着一定的地位，可始终被龙云飞和龙云沁压制一头，毕竟他只是大长老之孙，再怎么比也比不上族长的亲生儿女。
所以他只能弄一个属于自己的小圈子，成为圈子里的王，享受众星捧月所带来的爽感。
“都是兄弟，不必这么客气。”
“只要你们跟着我龙平，我保证不会让你们出事。”
“虽然在家族里，我们得在龙云飞和龙云沁两位圣子圣女面前低头弯腰，但在外面，我龙平还有着一定影响力的。”
“这一次，兄弟几个大难不死，反倒是圣子圣女而有所伤。”
“趁现在，正是我们一展宏图的机会！！”
龙平睁开双眸，眼神里充满狂热道。
“机会？什么机会？还请龙平哥直言！！”
说话的这位叫龙参，还是龙家最年轻一辈的族人，看上去和秦风差不多大。
“自然是上位的机会！！”
“我身为大长老之孙，也有着通天境修为，只要让我爷爷在上面疏通一下，说不定也能成为家族圣子。”
“到时候，我就和龙云飞，龙云沁平起平坐了。”
“也就不会再看他们脸色行事。”
“你们跟着我，又岂会有苦头吃？？”

第十七章，再杀龙平！！
“哈哈哈哈！！”

Chapter 17: Kill Long Ping again! !
Seeing the shopkeeper's dead expression, Qin Feng did not hesitate too much, but squatted down and groped around on his body.
Soon, he touched what he wanted, and couldn't help but smile as he said: "It's not yet time to put it into storage. This year's profits from the Dragon Phoenix Tower belong to me, Qin Feng. Let's treat it as the funeral money for Grandpa Longye."
As soon as he finished speaking, Qin Feng stood up immediately and began to look around.
He knew that in this room, there was a hidden compartment with a Qiankun bag inside, and inside the bag was the Longfeng Tower's income this year.
Now that he and the Long family have reached the point where water and fire are incompatible, he must get more spiritual stones for future use.
Only in this way, no matter which city you go to, you can seek refuge with the help of spiritual stones.
Time waits for no one.
Qin Feng started to get busy, constantly using his body skills to search in the room. During the process, he also picked up the shopkeeper's body and found out the Qiankun bag on his body.
Due to time constraints, Qin Feng did not check how many spiritual stones or precious objects were inside.
But he knows that as the shopkeeper of Longfeng Tower, this guy must be full of food. As long as he can complete the goals set by the Long family every year, the remaining spiritual stones will belong to the private property of his shopkeeper.
At this moment, in the private room on the second floor.
Long Ping, along with a group of young men from the Long family, planned to take advantage of the fact that the family had no time to care about him and others because of Qin Feng's affairs, and planned to have a big meal at Longfeng Tower without getting drunk.
That's why we have the current picture.
I saw Long Ping sitting in the main seat, with six or seven young people from the Long family sitting on the left and right sides, looking very majestic.
Although Long Ping participated in the search for Qin Feng this time, he spent most of his time fishing. Coupled with his identity as the grandson of the great elder, many senior family officials turned a blind eye to his fishing attitude.
The same goes for the losers around him.
After all, who dares to provoke the family elder who is inferior to one person and superior to ten thousand people?
"Brother Long Ping, it's thanks to you that we escaped the disaster. Otherwise, we would have been fatally or severely injured like those Dragon City monks by the spiritual energy fluctuations of the clan leader and the fierce bird king."
"Yes, Brother Long Ping, if you hadn't taken us away in time, I might have gone down to see Tai Nai."
"Yes, yes, without Brother Long Ping, how would we have the chance to still be sitting here?"
“Come, let’s all toast to Brother Long Ping!!”
"..."
As soon as the words fell, the younger generation of the Long family around the round table stood up one after another, raised their glasses and looked at Long Ping.
The latter enjoyed this moment very much. He closed his eyes slightly and his face was filled with a proud smile.
In the family, although Long Ping also has a certain status, he is always suppressed by Long Yunfei and Long Yunqin. After all, he is only the grandson of the great elder, and he cannot compare with the biological children of the patriarch.
So he can only create a small circle of his own, become the king of the circle, and enjoy the refreshing feeling brought by the stars holding the moon.
"We are all brothers, there is no need to be so polite."
"As long as you follow me, Long Ping, I promise that nothing will happen to you."
"Although within the family, we have to bow before the two saints, Long Yunfei and Long Yunqin, but outside, I, Long Ping, still have a certain influence."
"This time, the brothers survived the catastrophe, but the Holy Son and the Saint were injured."
"Now is our chance to show off our ambition!!"
Long Ping opened his eyes, his eyes full of enthusiasm.
"Opportunity? What opportunity? Brother Long Ping, please speak out!!"
The person who spoke was called Long Shen, and he was the youngest member of the Long family. He looked about the same age as Qin Feng.
"Of course it's an opportunity to get the upper hand!!"
"As the grandson of the Great Elder, I also have the cultivation level of Tongtian Realm. As long as my grandfather can clear it up, I might be able to become the Holy Son of the family."
"ArriveAt that time, I was on an equal footing with Long Yunfei and Long Yunqin. "
“You will no longer act based on their faces. "
"How can you suffer if you follow me? ? "

“Hahahaha! ! "
